en-US.title: Signal Sigma
en-US.subtitle: Paper and live Tradier desk
en-US.description:
Signal Sigma is a personal desk for the operator’s own Signal Sigma and Tradier accounts.

See equity, open P&L, broker positions, the Signal Sigma target book, pending orders, and realized performance. Switch paper and live. Unlock to rebalance or place orders. Live place-order actions ask for confirmation first.

This is not a public brokerage. It does not open accounts, custody funds, or give investment advice. It talks only to the operator’s self-hosted desk.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: overview, positions, orders, performance, paper/live, and desk actions.
en-US.promoText: Your Signal Sigma book and Tradier desk, on the phone.

review.notes: Personal companion to a self-hosted Signal Sigma / Tradier desk. Unlock with the desk password (email the developer for a current review password). Stay on Paper. Do not enable Live exec or Place orders on live. The API is https://signal-sigma.coolify.chapilabs.com.
